role: While a villager is trading, looks at the customer instead of running the plain watch-player search: shouldExecute just takes the customer.

members.name: theMerchant
members.note: folded: the task runs on the villager itself (struct living); the customer is its buying_player

members.name: EntityAILookAtTradePlayer
members.note: registered as AIC_LOOK_AT_TRADE_PLAYER, priority 1, mutex 2, 8.0f max distance

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: AIC_LOOK_AT_TRADE_PLAYER case: isTrading (buying_player), no RNG draw, unlike the parent's

notes: Everything else is inherited from EntityAIWatchClosest and implemented by the AIC_LOOK_AT_TRADE_PLAYER cases in ai.c: continueExecuting re-checks the 8-block distance and look_time, startExecuting draws lookTime = 40 + rand(40), updateTask looks at the player at eye height 1.62 with 10/40 speeds. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records trade-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
